title: The Knocking Below
text: The miners have stopped work. Behind the deepest face of your mine something is knocking back, three and three, the way the miners knock to say they are alive.

options.label: Break through to whatever is knocking, in case a crew still lives.

outcomes.text: Beyond the wall lie a lost seam of iron and the bones of an old crew, who knocked until they could not.
Beyond the wall is a cave of black glass, singing faintly.
The wall comes down on the Scion who led the dig.

options.label: Knock back, three and three, and wait for an answer.

outcomes.text: The knocking stops. For a while the seam beyond gives freely.
It knocks back, closer. Then it knocks under the Seat's cellar floor.

options.label: Collapse the gallery to bury whatever knocks.

outcomes.text: The gallery comes down. The mine yields less this Year, and the miners swear they can still hear it, fainter.
